items.title: Nutcracker Dance Lesson Outline
items.alt: Ballet teacher raising one arm beside a boy in a short decorative jacket holding a small nutcracker.
items.description: The teacher demonstrates a curved raised arm while the boy watches with the toy held against his jacket. Their separate grounded poses and complete soft shoes keep the lesson scene clear.

items.title: Packing a Nutcracker Toy Box Outline
items.alt: Older man placing a crowned nutcracker into an open wooden toy box beside a drum and wheeled horse.
items.description: The kneeling maker lowers the crowned toy into a cloth-lined wooden chest. The open lid, side handle, small drum and wheeled horse create a detailed packing scene.
